Question 5
?

Which of the following is equivalent to the integral ∫Cx4y2ds, where C is the section of the polar curve r=tan⁡θ for π6≤θ≤π3?

a
∫π/6π/3sin2⁡θcos2⁡θ+1dθ
b
∫π/6π/3sin2⁡θcos4⁡θ+1dθ
c
∫π/6π/3sin2⁡θcos2⁡θ−1dθ
d
∫π/6π/3sin4⁡θcos2⁡θ+1dθ
e
∫π/6π/3sin4⁡θcos4⁡θ−1dθ
Submit
